revealWordProblem.title: Apply: Evidence Bags
revealWordProblem.text: Agent Park has 6 pounds of evidence powder to log. Each labeled evidence bag holds exactly 2/3 of a pound. How many bags can Agent Park fill with all 6 pounds? Explain your reasoning.

choiceFeedback: That's multiplication. Are we finding groups or finding how many pieces fit?
Division by a fraction asks 'how many fit,' not multiplication.
That's computing division by whole numbers. Remember: dividing by 1/3 is different.
hints: The divisor is 2/3 — not a unit fraction — so the flip matters even more here.
Keep 6, change ÷ to ×, and flip the whole fraction 2/3 (both numbers trade places).
2/3 flips to 3/2, giving 6 × 3/2. Multiply, then simplify the result before choosing.
reviewCheck.explanationEs: 6 ÷ 2/3 = 6 × 3/2 = 18/2 = 9. Mantén el 6, cambia ÷ por × e invierte 2/3 a 3/2.
hintsEs: El divisor es 2/3, que no es una fracción unitaria, así que invertir importa aún más aquí.
Conserva el 6, cambia ÷ por × e invierte la fracción completa 2/3 (los dos números cambian de lugar).
2/3 se invierte a 3/2, y queda 6 × 3/2. Multiplica y luego simplifica el resultado antes de elegir.
